advisory_items.finding: scratch/verify_replay.py:restore_modes() forces every mode of the fresh-delivery copy to 0644 and then back to the manifest value before that leg's manifest check (observed mode_reset_and_restore_count=45). This makes the fresh-delivery leg structurally blind to mode drift - the exact class of defect that escaped in BLOCKING-1 - and is itself a mode-rewrite step in the replay path (external copy only, disclosed).
advisory_items.suggested_fix: Remove restore_modes() so the copytree result is checked as-is, or verify modes before any rewrite. If a mode reset is needed to simulate a fresh delivery, record the pre-rewrite mismatch rather than erasing it.

advisory_items.finding: The manifest records umask-dependent modes, mixing 11 entries of 100644 with 29 entries of 100664. A checkout or copy under a different umask would mismatch those entries even when the execute bit is correct.
advisory_items.suggested_fix: Record only the git-normalized mode (100644/100755), or normalize file modes before hashing.

advisory_items.finding: caller_validator.py raises bare SystemExit for a --runtime-root inside the delivered run tree, and verify_replay.py does the same for an in-tree or pre-existing --work-root. Both emit no JSON result object, so a caller falls back to MALFORMED_RESULT/FC_INTERNAL instead of a canonical FC_ARBITRARY_PATH (or equivalent). Fail-closed, but off the declared error surface. Verified: both refusals fire correctly and write nothing.
advisory_items.suggested_fix: Emit the normal rejected JSON envelope with a canonical fail_closed_code for these guard rails.

justification: T5 v3 is a substantial and genuine improvement over v2, and its central repair holds up under independent reproduction. The T5R-02 replay-stability blocking is substantively closed: the delivered entry point runs with no prerequisites, no prepare path exists anywhere in the run, P01 uses max_tick_age_minutes=0 which the underlying tool implements as 'no upper age bound' while still rejecting future timestamps so the fixed past tick is genuinely replay-stable, P09 generates its bounded tick only in an external runtime root, all four rounds return 23/23 with identical normalized outcomes, and my own before/after scan of sha256, bytes, mode and mtime_ns over all 46 delivered files proves zero writes. All four T5R-02 advisories are folded and I re-verified each adversarially: registry substitution is rejected at FC_INPUT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH with the decoy never executing, target byte identity is enforced before execution at FC_OPERATION_TARGET_IDENTITY_MISMATCH, the full matrix is collected before a nonzero return (reproduced independently), the independent-pin fixture and scope_boundary exist, and the formatting is normalized. Every T5R-01 regression is preserved, including the watcher execute bit in the worktree, the .git index and HEAD. However the package is not self-evidencing: under its own declared hash_domain of sha256_file_bytes_plus_mode, four manifest entries declare mode 100755 for files that are non-executable in the worktree, the .git index and the HEAD tree of the delivered commit, and the delivered sole no-prerequisite entry point consequently returns rc=3 while six delivered surfaces assert manifest 45/45 and passed:true. That is a direct failure of card A-common and of FP-RAW-RECORD-INTEGRITY, and it is the same defect class as T5R-01 BLOCKING-1: the mode discipline reached required_executables but not the manifest's own mode field. T5R-01 established that a headline claim which cannot be independently reproduced from the delivered state is blocking, and T5R-02 applied that standard to v2; applying it consistently to v3 yields REJECTED. The defect is narrow, local and cheap to fix - it needs only byte/mode bookkeeping and one re-run, with no authority expansion, no experiment rerun and no frozen-file change - so REJECTED is chosen over PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW, matching T5R-02's reasoning for the same remediation profile. No evidence of fabrication, authority violation or frozen-file modification was found; the author's recorded evidence was plausibly true when produced and the failure is evidence durability at the commit boundary.
